purpose: IronJot icon exploration; concept sheets, not selected production assets

prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand / sketch-to-render. Deliverable: one professional landscape concept exploration sheet for IronJot, a fast local workout logging app. The attached black-line sketch is the owner's EDIT TARGET and composition reference. Upgrade it into THREE carefully drawn icon studies on this one sheet, in a single row, equal size, generous margins on warm white paper. Preserve the fundamental clever idea in each: a large flexing muscular biceps curves across the lower half, forearm rises along the right, the SINGLE hand at the top holds a short pen whose tip points down-left onto a tilted note sheet behind the upper-left of the arm. The flexing arm is itself the writing arm, not a disconnected second hand. Clear anatomical silhouette; simple grip, no extra fingers. Page, arm, pen are separate recognizable geometric layers suitable for assembly animation. No words inside any icon; replace sketch's handwriting with just two very short note lines. First study: thick monoline black line art, faithful and simplified, titled below 'A / Clean outline'. Second study: flat geometric vector-like silhouette, charcoal rounded-square app tile, warm ivory paper, muted coral arm, ivory pen with dark separation, titled below 'B / Bold geometry'. Third study: simple CSG style soft 3D icon from fused rounded geometric solids, charcoal tile, matte coral arm and ivory paper, no skin pores or realistic anatomy, minimal bevel depth and soft studio light, titled below 'C / Soft volume'. All three icon compositions must be clean and readable at small app icon sizes, no micro-detail or ornament. Make the pen visible distinct from the hand, and paper visible distinct from the arm. Heading text only 'IronJot / Your sketch, refined'. Very polished design exploration, not busy presentation slides. No watermarks, no other text. Landscape 1536x1024-like aspect ratio.

Use case: logo-brand. Deliverable: one polished landscape icon concept exploration sheet for IronJot, a workout logging app connecting pumping iron with jotting down notes. THREE distinct original logo ideas, three equal large app tiles in one row on a warm white sheet, spacious editorial layout. All should be bold, extremely simple, geometric, professional icons, not cartoon mascots, with charcoal, warm ivory, and muted coral palette. NO lettering inside icons. First icon titled below 'D / Barbell pen': an ingenious diagonal writing pen with two very simple compact weight plates near the top so it reads as a dumbbell and pen combined, nib touching a single folded-corner note sheet. One pen and one paper, no arm. Strong flat vector-like mark on charcoal squircle. Second icon titled below 'E / Flexed page': one folded sheet of ivory paper whose outer shape smartly becomes a flexed biceps silhouette, one coral pen crossing near the top and a tiny note stroke, designed as a simple single unified symbol with meaningful negative space. Paper/strength fusion, not two disconnected symbols. Third icon titled below 'F / Pocket notebook': a minimal upright ivory pocket notebook with an oversized bold coral flexing-arm emblem and a short charcoal pen tucked into its right edge, clean geometric badge, two-color screenprint feel, charcoal rounded-square base. No spiral ring micro-detail. Each design distinct in silhouette and idea; maintain realistic app-icon simplicity with broad negative space and clean separable shapes that could animate into place. Heading text only 'IronJot / New directions'. Design exploration quality, clean lines, no realism, no decorative objects, no watermarks, no small illegible text. Landscape 1536x1024-like aspect ratio.
